The role supports installation, configuration, commissioning, verification, documentation and handover of infrastructure services including network, server, storage, cabling, Wi-Fi, IT room and related ICT components. The role works under the direction of IT and project leadership and collaborates with Engineering, Facilities, Automation, Quality, Global IT Operations, vendors and project teams to ensure infrastructure is delivered safely, securely, compliantly and in accordance with approved standards and project requirements. Project Governance: Participate in Tiered meetings, manage infrastructure risks, issues and actions, and provide status updates to project leadership. IT Room and Asset Standards: Support good housekeeping, access discipline, labelling, environmental monitoring, cable management, asset traceability and quality standards within IT rooms, MDFs, DFs, IDFs and server spaces. Ability to follow approved procedures, standards, drawings, method statements and project instructions while working safely in construction, commissioning or operational environments. Good understanding of LAN/WAN, VLANs, switching, routing, Active Directory, ITIL practices, change control and incident management principles. Strong communication, documentation, stakeholder coordination and problem-solving skills. High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-moving project environment. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE Experience in pharmaceutical, GMP, GxP or other highly regulated environments. Experience supporting FAT, SAT, installation verification, commissioning packs, construction turnover packs, vendor turnover packs or operational handover documentation. Knowledge of ServiceNow, CMDB, asset lifecycle management, change management and supplier follow-up processes.
